summary: Created Redux state structure for SMS message scheduling and management. Installed @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux, defined JSDoc type definitions (MessageStatus enum, Message and SmsState interfaces), created smsSlice with reducers (addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, setError) and selectors (selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus), configured Redux store with configureStore, and wired Provider into main.jsx.
